data.name: Sankari
data.gender_notes: Sankari is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who is the goddess of fortune and prosperity, and who is often depicted with the god Ganesha. The name Sankari carries the meaning “Goddess of fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Sankari usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and grace of the divine feminine, and is a reminder of the abundance and prosperity that can be found within.
data.etymology: Sankari belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sankari total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
